cities.name: Skopje
cities.local_food_tip: Makedonska kuhinja nudi puno laganih jela: povrtne čorbe, pasulj, pite, sveže salate i mediteranske kombinacije — ukusno i jednostavno.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏛️ Stone Bridge (Exterior): iconic landmark connecting old & new Skopje. → 🎭 Old Bazaar: narrow streets, local artisan shops, oriental charm. → ☕ Bazaar café break.

Afternoon: 🌊 Vardar Riverside Walk. → 🏛️ Macedonia Square (Exterior). → 🍽️ Lunch: shopska salad, bean dishes, pita, veggie stews. → 🕌 Mustafa Pasha Mosque (Exterior courtyard).

Sunset: 🌅 Kale Fortress viewpoint.

Night: 🌃 Center lights + dessert or pastry streets.
public_transport_tips: 🚌 City buses cover all main areas.
🚶 The central districts are very walkable.

city_events.name: Skopje Jazz Festival
city_events.description: 🎷 International jazz event across city venues.

cities.name: Bitola
cities.local_food_tip: Lagana tradicionalna jela: pasulj, pite, povrtne čorbe, salate i hleb sa susamom.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🎭 Širok Sokak: long pedestrian street full of cafés and old architecture. → ☕ Café break.

Afternoon: 🏛️ Heraclea Lyncestis (Exterior). → 🍽️ Lunch: soups, salads, pastries. → 🌿 City park.

Sunset: 🌅 Pedestrian boulevard.

Night: 🌃 Soft city lights & dessert spots.

cities.name: Kumanovo
cities.local_food_tip: Topli domaći obroci: povrtne supe, pite, salate i jednostavni mediteranski ukusi.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏛️ Main square walk. → ☕ Local café.

Afternoon: 🎭 Murals & urban art streets. → 🍽️ Lunch: soups, pitas, salads. → 🌿 City park.

Sunset: 🌅 Center viewpoints.

Night: 🌃 Evening lights & dessert shops.

cities.name: Ohrid
cities.local_food_tip: Lagana jela: salate, čorbe, pite, hleb, povrće i mediteranski ukusi — sve uz jezersku atmosferu.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌊 Lake Ohrid promenade. → 🏛️ Church of St. John at Kaneo (Exterior viewpoint). → ☕ Lakeside café.

Afternoon: 🎭 Old Town walk. → 🍽️ Lunch: salads, soups, bread dishes. → 🌿 Park by the lake.

Sunset: 🌅 Kaneo cliffs.

Night: 🌃 Promenade lights + dessert bars.
public_transport_tips: 🚖 Taxis are affordable for short trips

city_events.name: Ohrid Summer Festival
city_events.description: 🎶 Major cultural festival with concerts & performances.

cities.name: Prilep
cities.local_food_tip: Domaća jela: povrtne čorbe, pite, salate, pita s krompirom i lagane kombinacije.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏛️ Marko’s Towers (Exterior viewpoint). → ☕ City café.

Afternoon: 🎭 Center walk. → 🍽️ Lunch: soups, pita, salads. → 🌿 City park.

Sunset: 🌅 Hill views.

Night: 🌃 Old-town lights.
